{"reason": "Failure rows show two unknown clusters that are truly demand-forecast-error: small forecast biases (0.065-0.081) just below the 0.1 threshold, and market-signal-mismatch events. I lower the bias threshold to 0.05 and add one branch classifying market-signal-mismatch events as 'demand-forecast-error, recovering those rows without touching existing supplier-delay/forecast decisions.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
